_comment: Monitoring Agent — Hotelling T² anomaly detection. Edit values here, no code changes. Signal order must match the four baseline-backed fields in bearing_master.

anomaly._method_comment: Primary score = T² normalised to 0-1 via chi-square CDF. Z-scores are retained for evidence and triggered_features only.
anomaly._threshold_comment: chi2_CDF(T², p) >= threshold -> emit AnomalyEvent. 0.85 ≈ 85th percentile of the null distribution — well above healthy noise but sensitive enough to catch early faults.
anomaly._min_comment: Minimum number of non-null, non-imputed signals needed to compute T². Below this, return None (cannot assess).
anomaly._order_comment: Must match the order used to build the 4x4 correlation matrix from bearing_master.
anomaly._trigger_comment: A signal whose |z| >= trigger_z is listed in triggered_features. Used for evidence only — not for the primary score.
anomaly._impute_comment: Fields filled by the remediation step are excluded from T² — we never raise an anomaly against a value we invented.

regime._comment: Detection is suppressed unless the machine is in a running regime.

ewma._comment: EWMA control-chart drift detector. Runs in parallel to T². Either method can fire AnomalyEvent. Catches slow degradation that T² (point-in-time) misses.
ewma._alpha_comment: Smoothing factor (0,1]. Lower = more smoothing / slower response. 0.2 is a standard choice for slow drift.
ewma._L_comment: Out-of-control when |EWMA - mean| >= L * sigma_ewma, where sigma_ewma = std * sqrt(alpha/(2-alpha)). L=3 ~ 3-sigma control chart.
